title: Conditional Quantum Flow Matching for Data-Scarce Physiological Signal Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.14019v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative augmentation is a standard remedy for label scarcity in physiological signal classification, but existing quantum generative models start from uninformative noise, ignoring class structure that is already available. We propose Conditional Quantum Flow Matching (CQFM): a single 306-parameter circuit, conditioned on both flow time and class label, transports a compact class-conditional prior toward the target distribution. Quantum flow matching as published is unconditional, so this is to our knowledge the first conditional one, and the first EEG augmentation on a parameterized quantum circuit. A nonnegative spectral embedding removes the need for tomography at readout. On BCI Competition IV-2a, starting from a prior rather than noise is worth $+5.1$ accuracy points over QuDDPM (9/9 subjects), though at that operating point a class-conditional Gaussian matches CQFM. Where the prior fails the transport earns its keep: given one

translated_title: 面向数据稀缺生理信号增强的条件量子流匹配
translated_abstract: 生成式增强是解决生理信号分类中标签稀缺问题的标准方法，但现有的量子生成模型从无信息的噪声出发，忽略了本已可用的类别结构。我们提出了条件量子流匹配：一个仅含306个参数的量子电路，同时以流时间和类别标签为条件，将一个紧凑的类条件先验分布输运至目标分布。已发表的量子流匹配是无条件的，因此据我们所知，这是首个条件量子流匹配模型，也是首个在参数化量子电路上实现的脑电（EEG）数据增强方法。非负谱嵌入消除了读出时对量子态层析的需求。在BCI Competition IV-2a数据集上，从先验分布而非噪声出发，相比QuDDPM可带来+5.1个百分点的准确率提升（9/9名受试者均有效），不过在该工作点上，类条件高斯模型即可达到与CQFM相当的性能。而当先验失效时，流匹配的输运才真正体现其价值：给定一个……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出首个条件量子流匹配模型CQFM，仅用306个参数的量子电路同时以流时间和类别标签为条件，实现参数化量子电路上的首次脑电信号增强，在BCI Competition IV-2a上比QuDDPM提升5.1个百分点准确率。
en_tdlr: Proposes Conditional Quantum Flow Matching (CQFM), the first conditional quantum flow model—conditioned on both flow time and class label—using a single 306-parameter circuit to achieve the first EEG augmentation on a parameterized quantum circuit, gaining +5.1 accuracy points over QuDDPM on BCI Competition IV-2a.
